summary.text: Penny Morales Shaw is a Democratic member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 148 since January 12, 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an attorney by profession.

paragraphs.text: Penny Morales Shaw was born in Houston, Texas.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as including work as an attorney, a U.S. congressional legislative advocate, and an owner and administrator of three businesses.

In the Texas House, Morales Shaw served on the Environmental Regulation and Urban Affairs committees in 2021-2022, and in 2023-2024 she was assigned to the Defense & Veterans' Affairs, Environmental Regulation, and Local & Consent Calendars committees.
She defeated Kay Smith in the November 5, 2024 general election, 54.9% to 45.1%.
Ballotpedia lists Amanda LaBrie as the Republican candidate opposing her in the November 3, 2026 general election.
